name: justfill-pdf-forms
description: Detect, review and fill fields in existing PDF forms, including flat PDFs and scans, and save reusable templates.
long_description: JustFill PDF Forms completes the PDF you already have instead of recreating it. Open an authorized form and JustFill finds its fields: saved templates and native AcroForm fields are used exactly, and flat PDFs, scans and phone photos go through machine-learning field detection with a confidence score per field. The assistant shows you a visual preview of the detected boxes and of your values in place before it generates anything, then fills the original document. After a fill you can save the reviewed layout as a private template so recurring forms fill deterministically.
